description: Activate when: user says 'which work can we hand to an AI agent', 'how far can this process be automated', 'does the agent need human approval', 'how much permission should the agent get', asks 'can the agent just do this on its own?', or is preparing to let an agent take over a business process. Do NOT activate when: the question is only which AI tool to buy (use build-buy-partner-ai); the process is not yet defined and is done differently every time. More: deciqai.com/c/agent-delegability-assessment

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
